coarse_teacher: Eight mode-6 Godunov steps with 1e-08 m depth tolerance
pde_reference: Analytic at cell-average level on dam inputs; fourfold spatial and temporal refinement of the original Godunov solver starting from the same supplied, piecewise-constant coarse profile for all other families.
timings: Median across randomized, warmed, single-core native full-batch elapsed times divided by profile count. Includes input preparation internal to each method, prediction, routing, and all fallback solves. Cached offline references excluded.
cfl_policy: Within a block choose ceil(8*dt/dx * max(|u|+sqrt(gh)) / .90) steps, clamped to [1,8]. If the evolution reports a CFL or positivity failure with a reduced step count, retry with eight substeps from the original profile. Both attempts are included.
shock_metric: Absolute shock-position error in coarse cells. Interpolate the crossing of the midpoint between the analytic intermediate depth and the downstream depth, choosing the steepest same-sign crossing when oscillatory. Dam cases only.
